exploit_name: Minimum reward-per-hour validation applied to gross instead of net amount
description: Minimum reward-per-hour validation occurs before protocol fees are deducted. Check validates gross amount, then fees subtracted, reducing actual distribution below required minimum.
root_cause: Minimum reward-per-hour validation occurs before protocol fees are deducted. Check validates gross amount, then fees subtracted, reducing actual distribution below required minimum.
fix_description: Move minimum rate validation to occur after fee computation, validating against net amount.
notes: Campaign creators deploy campaigns appearing to meet minimum rate but actually paying recipients less than required.
